Cell.Text: Yeah, you can say so. Just got here to rest a bit after the road.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA1: Hello, never seen you here before. Adventurer, I guess?

Cell.Text: That's all right, I don't mind some chatting with locals. | My name is Maria, and you are?

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA2: Oh, sorry then, I'll not bother you.

Cell.Text: Drunken Huntsman is great place for relaxation after journeys and adventures, don't you think so?

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA4: Yeah, espetially then Nazeem is not here.

Cell.Text: Right, I don't know everyone here yet, but I'll concider keeping distance from him.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA5: No, just not quite pleasant one to talk.

Cell.Text: Need to order some drinks, for our meeting here.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA6: How about drink? I have good mead here. (share bottle) For our meeting.

Cell.Text: Yeah, it's Billy here. Husky is rare dog, but still could be found. Armor for safety in adventures.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA7: Is it your dog here? An armored husky? I thought only Dawnguard guys have those.

Cell.Text: *Giggles* Sure, I can always rely on him, so as he on me.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA8: And it's safer to travel with such strong dog as well.

Cell.Text: You know, I was really looking for some company for adventures, if you wish we could travel together.

Node.Caption: lope_MariaMeeting_helloA9: Perhaps I need to get dog to myself as well, to watch my back in adventures.

Cell.Text: [S] All right, just say then you wish to hit the road, Billy and I will accompany you. | We'll stay here for the rest time, I think.
